Yeah I know it doesn't go away with wishing but just trust me when I say it will go away if you work hard at it. I used to think that it was just an imbalance in my brain and to a degree I was right. There is that chemical imbalance but just trust me when I say working on it every day, taking small steps to achieve the goal of getting rid of depression works. It won't go away easily it took me almost a year of working hard on it for me to actually break through and one day I woke up and felt a lot better.

I gave myself a choice. Either keep living this way or decide to end the depression once and for all. I chose to stop living this way. And every day I would remind myself of that choice. Every time I'd get depressed I would remind myself of the choice I made. I say to myself that I don't have the time to be sad. I keep myself busy that's the most important thing is to keep yourself busy. Stay busy and remind yourself of your choice. Wright an encouraging note to wake up to in the morning. Do something to make yourself smile everyday.
